"""固定实现的完整检查与离线工程诊断；不覆盖历史或新造人工答案。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round6-validation-cdc7351'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PATH'] = str(Path.home() / '.cargo/bin') + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
env['PYTHONUTF8'] = '1'
cargo = str(Path.home() / '.cargo/bin/cargo.exe')
commands = [
    ['rustc', '--version'], [cargo, 'fetch', '--locked'],
    [cargo, 'build', '--workspace', '--locked', '--offline'], [cargo, 'fmt', '--all', '--check'],
    [cargo, 'clippy', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline', '--', '-D', 'warnings'],
    [cargo, 'test', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline'],
    [cargo, 'test', '--workspace', '--doc', '--locked', '--offline'],
    [sys.executable, 'scripts/check_workspace.py'],
    [sys.executable, '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-p', 'test_*.py'],
    [cargo, 'build', '--workspace', '--release', '--locked', '--offline'],
]
commands[0][0] = str(Path.home() / '.cargo/bin/rustc.exe')
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).decode().strip()
assert head == 'cdc73515ad5356844f1df4fc3ee30194c5a15ab6'
report = {'implementation_commit': head, 'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'runner_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'checks': []}
for index, command in enumerate(commands, 1):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    row = {'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'seconds': time.perf_counter()-start,
           'stdout': result.stdout.decode('utf-8'), 'stderr': result.stderr.decode('utf-8')}
    report['checks'].append(row)
    (OUT / 'checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    print(json.dumps({'check': index, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'seconds': row['seconds']}), flush=True)
    if result.returncode:
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode)

"""冻结源码的源图双构建、实际阻塞、旧包只读身份和原型诊断。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import zipfile

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round6-diagnostics-cdc7351'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PATH'] = str(Path.home() / '.cargo/bin') + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
env['PYTHONUTF8'] = '1'
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).decode().strip()
assert head == 'cdc73515ad5356844f1df4fc3ee30194c5a15ab6'
subprocess.run(['git', 'archive', '--format=zip', '--output=' + str(OUT / 'source.zip'), head], check=True)
checkout = OUT / 'checkout'
checkout.mkdir()
with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT / 'source.zip') as archive:
    archive.extractall(checkout)
isolated = [sys.executable, '-I', '-X', 'utf8', '-c',
            'import sys,runpy;sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv.pop(1));runpy.run_module(sys.argv.pop(1),run_name="__main__")', str(checkout)]
source = ROOT / '.local/data-sources/zhwiktionary-prefix-8388608.jsonl'
lock = ROOT / 'data/sources/locks/wiktionary-zh-20261001-prefix8388608.json'
commands = [
    ('source-graph-a', isolated + ['tools.data_pipeline.source_assertions', '--source', str(source), '--lock', str(lock), '--output-dir', str(OUT/'graph-a')], 0),
    ('source-graph-b', isolated + ['tools.data_pipeline.source_assertions', '--source', str(source), '--lock', str(lock), '--output-dir', str(OUT/'graph-b')], 0),
    ('pending-audit', [sys.executable, '-m', 'tools.data_pipeline.annotation_workflow', '--packet', 'data/plans/ime-annotation-round6.json', '--output', str(OUT/'pending-audit.json')], 2),
    ('pending-freeze', [sys.executable, '-m', 'tools.data_pipeline.annotation_workflow', '--packet', 'data/plans/ime-annotation-round6.json', '--freeze', '--output', str(OUT/'pending-freeze')], 1),
    ('wikipedia-gate', [sys.executable, '-m', 'tools.data_pipeline.corpus_gate', '--revision', '.local/round6-wikipedia-acquisition/revision.utf8', '--page-id', '342', '--revision-id', '94816134', '--output', str(OUT/'wikipedia-gate.json')], 2),
    ('old-package-verify', [sys.executable, '-m', 'tools.data_pipeline', 'verify', '.local/round5-clean-6d3d4e1/release-a'], 0),
    ('archived-python-regression', [sys.executable, '-I', '-X', 'utf8', '-c',
       'import sys,unittest;sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]);r=unittest.TextTestRunner().run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover(sys.argv[1]+"/tests",pattern="test_*.py"));sys.exit(not r.wasSuccessful())', str(checkout)], 0),
    ('prototype', [sys.executable, 'scripts/benchmark.py', '--iterations', '1000', '--output', str(OUT/'prototype.json')], 0),
    ('old-seeds', [sys.executable, 'scripts/evaluate_algorithms.py', '--output-dir', str(OUT/'algorithm-v1')], 0),
]
report = {'implementation_commit': head, 'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'runner_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'checks': []}
for name, command, expected in commands:
    start = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    row = {'name': name, 'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'expected_returncode': expected,
           'seconds': time.perf_counter()-start, 'stdout': result.stdout.decode('utf-8'), 'stderr': result.stderr.decode('utf-8')}
    report['checks'].append(row)
    (OUT / 'diagnostics.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    print(json.dumps({'check': name, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'expected': expected, 'seconds': row['seconds']}), flush=True)
    if result.returncode != expected:
        raise SystemExit(1)

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

a, b = OUT/'graph-a', OUT/'graph-b'
assert {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in a.iterdir()} == {p.name:p.read_bytes() for p in b.iterdir()}
identity = {'implementation_commit': head, 'archive_sha256': sha(OUT/'source.zip'),
            'source_data_sha256': sha(source), 'source_lock_file_sha256': sha(lock),
            'source_graph_double_build_identical': True,
            'source_graph_files': {p.name:{'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(p)} for p in a.iterdir()},
            'production_code_unchanged': subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','c21db7c',head,'--','crates','apps','tools/data_pipeline/pipeline.py','tools/data_pipeline/word_source.py','tools/data_pipeline/recovery.py','tools/data_pipeline/cedict_source.py','tools/data_pipeline/filesystem.py']).decode().splitlines(),
            'old_package_files': {p.name:sha(p) for p in (ROOT/'.local/round5-clean-6d3d4e1/release-a').iterdir()},
            'language_metrics':{'top1':None,'top5':None,'mrr':None}, 'real_human_gold_delivered':False}
(OUT/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'double_build':True,'identity':str(OUT/'identity.json')}),flush=True)

"""只读独立核对源位置及双向lookup；资源诊断使用精确归档工具。"""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round6-diagnostics-cdc7351'
source = ROOT / '.local/data-sources/zhwiktionary-prefix-8388608.jsonl'
lines = source.read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)
records = [json.loads(row) for row in (OUT/'graph-a/assertions.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
lookup = json.loads((OUT/'graph-a/lookup.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
translation_ids = {}
senses = 0
for row in records:
    raw = lines[row['source']['line_number']-1]
    origin = json.loads(raw)
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == row['source']['line_sha256']
    assert origin['word'] == row['word'] and origin.get('pos') == row['pos'] and row['frequency'] is None
    for sense in row['senses']:
        original = origin['senses'][int(sense['source_pointer'].split('/')[-1])]
        assert original.get('glosses', []) == sense['glosses'] and original.get('tags', []) == sense['tags']
        senses += 1
    for translation in row['translations']:
        original = origin['translations'][int(translation['source_pointer'].split('/')[-1])]
        assert original['word'] == translation['word'] and original['lang_code'] == 'en'
        assert original.get('sense') == translation['source_sense_label'] and translation['sense_id'] is None
        identity = translation['id']
        assert identity not in translation_ids
        translation_ids[identity] = (row['word'], translation['word'])
        assert lookup['zh_to_en'][row['word']].count(identity) == 1
        assert lookup['en_to_zh'][translation['word']].count(identity) == 1
assert set(identity for values in lookup['zh_to_en'].values() for identity in values) == set(translation_ids)
assert set(identity for values in lookup['en_to_zh'].values() for identity in values) == set(translation_ids)
assert lookup['reverse_lookup_creates_reverse_assertions'] is False
code = '''import sys,json,time;from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1])
from tools.data_pipeline.source_assertions import build
from tools.data_pipeline.__main__ import peak_memory_bytes
start=time.perf_counter()
result=build(Path(sys.argv[2]),json.loads(Path(sys.argv[3]).read_text(encoding='utf-8')),Path(sys.argv[4]))
print(json.dumps({'build_seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'peak_process_working_set_bytes':peak_memory_bytes(),'source_graph':result},ensure_ascii=False))
'''
command = [sys.executable, '-I', '-X', 'utf8', '-c', code, str(OUT/'checkout'), str(source),
           str(ROOT/'data/sources/locks/wiktionary-zh-20261001-prefix8388608.json'), str(OUT/'graph-resource')]
start = time.perf_counter()
result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr.decode('utf-8')
value = {'implementation_commit':'cdc73515ad5356844f1df4fc3ee30194c5a15ab6',
         'source_pointer_records_checked':len(records),'source_senses_checked':senses,
         'directed_source_translations_checked':len(translation_ids),
         'both_lookup_indexes_checked':True,'language_truth_independently_verified':False,
         'resource_run':{'command':command,'returncode':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout.decode('utf-8'),
                         'stderr':result.stderr.decode('utf-8'),'wall_seconds':time.perf_counter()-start},
         'python_executable_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(sys.executable).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
         'limitations':['OS进程峰值含完整原件/行数组/图/序列化，不是单算法live内存或TSF性能。']}
(OUT/'graph-audit-resource.json').write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in value.items() if k != 'resource_run'},ensure_ascii=False))

"""本轮独立证据发布；原文封装保留UTF-8字节，Git展示件规范LF。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / 'docs/reports/cl009/round6'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
RAW = {}
FILES = {}


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def save(name, value):
    path = OUT / name
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')


def publish(source, name):
    data = source.read_bytes()
    text = data.decode('utf-8')
    RAW[name] = {'original_path': str(source), 'sha256': sha(data), 'bytes': len(data), 'utf8': text}
    path = OUT / name
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if source.suffix == '.json':
        save(name, json.loads(text))
    else:
        display = '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in text.splitlines()).rstrip()
        path.write_text(display + ('\n' if display else ''), encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    FILES[name] = {'original_sha256': sha(data), 'published_sha256': sha(path.read_bytes())}


checks = ROOT / '.local/round6-validation-cdc7351'
diag = ROOT / '.local/round6-diagnostics-cdc7351'
publish(checks/'checks.json', 'checks.json')
for name in ['diagnostics.json', 'identity.json', 'pending-audit.json', 'wikipedia-gate.json',
             'graph-audit-resource.json', 'prototype.json']:
    publish(diag/name, name)
publish(diag/'graph-a/manifest.json', 'graph-manifest.json')
for path in (diag/'algorithm-v1').iterdir():
    if path.is_file():
        publish(path, 'algorithm-v1/' + path.name)
for folder in ['round6-red', 'round6-red-bound', 'round6-red-source', 'round6-red-source-behavior']:
    for path in (ROOT/'.local'/folder).iterdir():
        if path.is_file():
            publish(path, 'red/' + folder + '/' + path.name)
publish(ROOT/'.local/round6-wikipedia-acquisition/requests.json', 'wikipedia-acquisition.json')
save('raw-artifacts.json', {'encoding':'UTF-8; utf8.encode reconstructs exact original bytes without newline translation', 'files':RAW})
save('provenance.json', {'implementation_commit':'cdc73515ad5356844f1df4fc3ee30194c5a15ab6',
     'published_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'files':FILES,
     'scope':'Research graph complete derived files remain in .local; no Wikipedia body or terms page redistributed in Git',
     'tool_files_sha256':{p.name:sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted((ROOT/'tools/data_pipeline').glob('*.py'))},
     'pending_tasks_sha256':sha((ROOT/'data/plans/ime-annotation-round6.json').read_bytes())})
baseline = 'c21db7ca70e5f51f84ca8bd30944d6722473c32c'
paths = subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-r','--name-only',baseline,'docs/reports']).decode().splitlines()
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',baseline,'--',*paths])
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--diff-filter=D','--name-only',baseline,'--','tests','crates'])
save('history-integrity.json', {'baseline':baseline,'checked_implementation':'cdc73515ad5356844f1df4fc3ee30194c5a15ab6',
     'historical_reports_unchanged':len(paths),'old_tests_deleted':[],
     'production_changes':subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',baseline,'cdc7351','--','crates','apps',
         'tools/data_pipeline/pipeline.py','tools/data_pipeline/recovery.py','tools/data_pipeline/word_source.py',
         'tools/data_pipeline/linguistic_sidecar.py','tools/data_pipeline/cedict_source.py']).decode().splitlines()})
save('runners.json', {'scope':'Actual runners, paths may be explicitly remapped after checking same inputs',
     'sources':[{'name':name,'sha256':sha((ROOT/'.local'/name).read_bytes()),'utf8':(ROOT/'.local'/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8')}
     for name in ['run_round6_data_checks.py','run_round6_data_diagnostics.py','audit_round6_graph.py','publish_round6_data.py']]})
save('checksums.json',{'scope':'Git LF publication bytes; excludes checksum manifest itself',
     'files':{path.relative_to(OUT).as_posix():sha(path.read_bytes()) for path in sorted(OUT.rglob('*')) if path.is_file()}})
print(json.dumps({'published':str(OUT),'original_files':len(RAW),'history_checked':len(paths)}))
